prompt.hi: Ek patti ke 3 barabar hisse hain aur 2 mein rang hai, yaani 2/3. Ab har hissa 4 chhote barabar hisson mein kaat diya. Rang wale hisse ko ab kaunse fraction se bolenge?
prompt.en: A strip has 3 equal parts with 2 coloured, that is 2/3. Now every part is cut into 4 smaller equal parts. Which fraction do we call the coloured part now?

hindi.hi: Ek patti ke 3 barabar hisse hain, 2 hisson mein rang bhara hai, yaani 2/3. Har hisse ke 4 chhote barabar hisse kar diye, toh rang wala hissa ab kaunsa fraction hua?
hindi.en: A strip has 3 equal parts, 2 of them filled with colour, that is 2/3. Each part was made into 4 small equal parts, so what fraction is the coloured part now?

did.hi: 2/3 ke barabar 12 hisson wala fraction banaya
did.en: made the fraction with 12 parts that equals 2/3

why.hi: Har hissa 4 mein kata, toh kul hisse 3 × 4 = 12 hue aur rang wale 2 × 4 = 8; rang utna hi raha, isliye 2/3 = 8/12.
why.en: Every part was cut into 4, so the parts became 3 × 4 = 12 and the coloured ones 2 × 4 = 8; the colour stayed the same, so 2/3 = 8/12.

simpler.hi: Pehle socho ki kul kitne chhote hisse bane. Phir socho ki rang wala har hissa kitne chhote hisse bana.
simpler.en: First think how many small parts there are in all. Then think how many small parts each coloured part became.

why.en: 4/8 is exactly half, but 3/7 is less than half: double 3 is only 6, not 7

why.en: the top and bottom of 1/3 times 3 give 3/9, times 4 give 4/12; 5/12 is not equal, so 2 are equal

say.en: These bars show 1/2 in 2 parts and 2/3 in 3 parts. In both the bottom is 1 more than the top, but 1/2 is exactly a half and 2/3 is more than a half. So we decide by multiplying, not by the gap.

simpler.hi: 1/2 aadha hai, 2/3 aadhe se zyada. Dono mein farak 1 hi hai, phir bhi maatra alag hai.
simpler.en: 1/2 is a half, 2/3 is more than a half. The gap is 1 in both, yet the amounts differ.

simpler.hi: Upar aur neeche 2 jodna guna karna nahi hai. Barabar bhinn ke liye dono ko ek hi number se guna karte hain.
